name: THT Air Solutions Heating & Cooling
address: 1241 Prosper Commons Blvd, Ste 111, Prosper, TX 75078
heroEvidence: When we searched "AC repair Prosper TX" on Google Maps, you came up first, ahead of every company that wasn't paying for an ad. You were also the only company on that list with no Website button.
working: 4.8 stars from 59 Google reviews, and customers mention Naib by name again and again for honesty, fast response, and taking the time to explain the problem.
Google already puts you at the top of the map for AC repair in Prosper, ahead of companies with four to seven times as many reviews.
A real office in Prosper Commons and an A+ rating with the BBB.
You post seasonal specials right on your Google listing, which most small shops never do.

costs.headline: Google is sending customers to a website that doesn't exist
costs.detail: Your Google Maps listing still shows thtairsolutions.com, but that address no longer works, and the name isn't registered to anyone right now. In regular Google search, your listing just says "Add website."
costs.cost: Before someone with a broken AC lets a stranger into their house, they want to check you out. Every company around you gives them a page to look at. You don't, and anyone could buy that web address while Google is still pointing your customers to it.

costs.headline: The reviews stopped coming in about two years ago
costs.detail: Your newest Google review is about two years old. Matco Services, right below you in the same search, shows 276 reviews; C.A.S. Air Conditioning shows 244.
costs.cost: Homeowners read the dates. A two-year gap makes people wonder if you're still busy, or still open, and fresh reviews help decide who stays at the top of the map.

costs.headline: Two different phone numbers depending on where people look
costs.detail: Google lists (877) 670-1934. Yelp, Nextdoor, the BBB, and MapQuest all list (214) 575-2323.
costs.cost: Google is where most of your calls start. If the 877 line isn't answered the same way as your main number, those calls could be slipping past you. Which number do you want customers calling?

competitorNote: In that same "AC repair Prosper TX" search, Matco Services (276 reviews) and C.A.S. Air Conditioning & Heating (244 reviews) showed up right below you, and both have a website button on their listing.
actions: Put up a simple website and connect it to your Google listing.
Text every customer a review link right after the job.
Pick one phone number and make every listing match.

topOpportunities.title: Put up a simple website and connect it to your Google listing
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: You're already winning the search. A real page with your services, your team, and your reviews gives the people who find you a reason to call you and not the next company down. Locking in the thtairsolutions.com name keeps someone else from taking it.

topOpportunities.title: Start collecting reviews again, automatically
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Fifty-nine customers have already given you a 4.8. The goodwill is there; it just stopped getting collected. A text with a review link after every job keeps it coming in without anyone having to remember.

topOpportunities.title: Make your phone number match everywhere
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: One number on Google, Yelp, Nextdoor, and the BBB means every call lands where you expect it, and Google has one consistent answer about who you are.

howChecked: We searched Google and Google Maps the way a Prosper homeowner would ("AC repair Prosper TX"), read your Google reviews newest-first, tried the website listed on your Google profile and checked whether the web address is still registered, and compared your phone number across Google, Yelp, Nextdoor, the BBB, and MapQuest.

name: Collision Kings Auto Body of McKinney
heroEvidence: When we searched "auto body shop McKinney TX" on Google Maps, you were the second shop listed that wasn't paying for an ad, ahead of CARSTAR and Texas Collision Centers. Of the top six, you were the only one with no Website button.
working: A perfect 5.0 from 262 Google reviews, new ones still coming in, and you reply to them.
Google already ranks you near the top of the map for auto body in McKinney, ahead of shops with more than twice your reviews.
You're still adding photos to your Google listing, so it looks active and cared for.
Your phone number, address, and hours match everywhere we looked, which a lot of shops get wrong.

costs.headline: Your Google listing doesn't link to your website
costs.detail: You have a site at ckmckinney.com, but your Google listing says "Add website." A customer on the map can only call you or get directions.
costs.cost: Someone comparing body shops taps Website on everyone else. On yours they can't, so your 30 years in the business and the help you offer with deductibles sit on a page they never reach.

costs.headline: Your website doesn't show your work
costs.detail: It's a single page. The main photo is a sports car that isn't from your shop, there are no before-and-after photos, and there's no list of services. A few words are misspelled too, like "experiance" and "costumers."
costs.cost: After an accident, people want to see paint matches and straight panels before they hand over their car. Your reviews say you do that work. Your site doesn't show it.

costs.headline: Outside of Google, almost nobody sees you
costs.detail: Your Facebook page has 6 followers, Yelp shows 1 review, and we couldn't find an Instagram account for the shop.
costs.cost: Every car you fix is a before-and-after that could be bringing in the next customer. Right now those results leave the shop and nobody else sees them.

competitorNote: In that same search, The Body Shop (439 reviews) and CARSTAR Vivid Collision (572 reviews) both link straight to a website from their Google listing. Your 5.0 rating beats both of theirs; their listings just give customers more to look at.
actions: Link your website to your Google listing.
Rebuild the site around your own work.
Turn finished jobs into short before-and-after videos.

topOpportunities.title: Link your website to your Google listing
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: It takes minutes and costs nothing, and every person who finds you on the map gets a page to look at before they call.

topOpportunities.title: Rebuild the site around your own work
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Real before-and-after photos, the services you offer, the insurance companies you work with, and your deductible help, all on one page a customer can trust.

topOpportunities.title: Turn finished jobs into short before-and-after videos
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Collision work is made for video. Posted to Google, Facebook, and Instagram, each repair keeps working for you long after the car leaves.

howChecked: We searched Google Maps for "auto body shop McKinney TX" and Google for your business name, read your Google listing and reviews, loaded your website, and compared your phone, address, and hours across Google, your site, Facebook, Yelp, and Nextdoor.
